raw_blocks: Trinity Industries, Inc. owns market-leading businesses that provide railcar products and services in North America under the trade name TrinityRail®. TrinityRail’s unique platform provides a single source for comprehensive rail transportation solutions that optimizes our customers’ ownership and usage of railcar equipment and enhances the value-proposition of the rail modal supply chain.

Our purpose is to Deliver Goods for the Good of All. We remain committed to rail solutions that deliver goods—safely, efficiently, and sustainably - for the good of our customers, shareholders, and employees in all the communities we serve.
Our common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange and NYSE Texas under the symbol TRN.
Delivering Goods for the Good of All™

It’s more than a motto — it’s our purpose. Rail transports the goods that keep our lives, our communities, and our economy thriving, and TrinityRail is proud to keep North America’s rail shippers moving forward.

TrinityRail is an industry-leading railcar leasing company, enhanced by our manufacturing and service capabilities. We are a leader in providing leasing and logistics services, and act as an integrated and strategic partner to stakeholders across the industry. We are on a mission to increase rail’s modal share and convenience by delivering more sustainable, end-to-end solutions that bridge the first and last miles for our customers.
years in business 50+ years manufacturing railcars, 40+ years leasing railcars
major commercial end markets serving 21 different commodity markets with the broadest railcar product offering in North America
invested in our lease fleet
Trinity Industries celebrating 50 years of being publicly traded on the NYSE on June 28, 2022

As a leading railcar lessor enabled by rail transportation manufacturing and services in North America, Trinity Industries is committed to supporting a more sustainable future and making meaningful contributions to address our long-term impact.

We are dedicated to integrating sustainability principles, including socially responsible and environmentally conscious corporate practices, grounded in a robust governance framework to ensure we continue operating at the industry's highest standards.

pages.raw_title: Trinity Industries, Inc. - About - About Us
raw_blocks: Trinity began providing industrial products and services to customers more than 85 years ago. We started as a small butane-tank manufacturer and evolved over time into a premier provider of railcar products and services in North America with a leading railcar lease fleet and manufacturing, maintenance and repair operations. We have a long history of creating value for our shareholders by providing quality products and services to our customers.

Our rail-related products and services are marketed under the trade name TrinityRail . Our purpose is to Deliver Goods for the Good of All . We remain committed to rail solutions that deliver goods—safely, efficiently, and sustainably - for the good of our customers, shareholders, and employees in all the communities we serve.

The TrinityRail platform plays an important role in the North American supply chain by facilitating the transportation of bulk commodities and goods by rail. Railcar transportation is sustainable and is the most economical land-based mode of transportation. At Trinity, we strive to employ company resources in ways that make positive contributions to our stakeholders for the benefit of current and future generations.

TrinityRail’s platform aims to deliver innovative solutions that optimize the life-cycle ownership and usage of railcar equipment and enhance the value-proposition of the rail modal supply chain. We differentiate our value proposition to all stakeholders by:
leveraging our rail expertise across a broad market viewpoint,
working collaboratively to provide an unparalleled customer experience, and
delivering significant financial and commercial synergies that create a strategic advantage.
Our market leadership, performance and growth through the years are attributable to:
the skills, talents, and integrity of our people,
the synergies within our platform,
the quality of our rail products and services,
the depth of our operational capabilities, market insight and expertise, and
our cultural commitment to excellence and continuous improvement.

pages.raw_title: Trinity Industries, Inc. - About - Trinity Platform
raw_blocks: The TrinityRail Platform and Operating Model

At Trinity, we are committed to Delivering Goods for the Good of All . Look around and you’ll see us. Your home and workplace? Our railcars have likely carried the materials that built them. The food on your family’s table? We may have delivered it from the farm to grocer. The car in your driveway? We likely transported and fueled it. Sparkling clean drinking water? That’s us too.

Our railcars play an important role in North America as they deliver essential goods that keep the economy moving and enrich the lives of people in communities across the continent. At Trinity, we remain committed to rail solutions that deliver goods— safely, efficiently, and sustainably - for the good of our customers, shareholders, and employees in all the communities we serve.
Delivering Goods for the Good of All is why we proudly come to work each day.

Our Core Values are the foundational characteristics of our Company. We strive to live these Core Values throughout our daily work and interactions with each other, our customers, and our shareholders. Each serves as our cultural cornerstone and defines how we accomplish our purpose. We align our business strategy with three broad initiatives: optimization, innovation, and customer experience - all with the goal to deliver superior returns to our stakeholders and achieve our overarching purpose of Delivering Goods for the Good of All.
